heroHeadline: Huawei's Chip Breakthrough and DeepSeek V4 Signal China's AI Independence as Trump and Putin Both Court Xi in Beijing
heroSubtitle: In a pivotal month for China's global standing, Xi Jinping hosted US President Trump (May 14–17) and Russian President Putin (May 20) in back-to-back state summits — while Huawei unveiled its Tau Scaling Law chip architecture and Nvidia's CEO conceded China's AI market. From the Xia Dynasty's legendary founding ~2070 BCE to the world's most consequential great-power chess match of 2026 — 4,000 years of Chinese civilization tracked in real time.
footerNote: Data sourced from official Chinese government reports (NBS, MFA, NPC, PLARF), major news outlets (Reuters, AP, BBC, Xinhua, SCMP, CNBC, CNN), academic scholarship, and international institutional analyses (UN, IMF, World Bank, SIPRI, ASPI, USCC, AEI, CFR).
